commit_message: GATE-11: contribution proofs — bilateral receipts, append-only ledger, self-report forbidden
scope_completed: BilateralReceipt: mutually-signed attestation (gateway + peer both sign over measured service)
createBilateralReceipt: both parties sign the receipt body (domain-separated canonical CBOR)
verifyBilateralReceipt: BOTH signatures must verify (unilateral = no credit)
ContributionProof: derived ONLY from a verified bilateral receipt (BLAKE3 receipt hash for dedup)
createContributionProof: verifies the receipt first, then creates the proof — self-reported traffic CANNOT create a proof
ContributionLedger: append-only (no remove/delete), dedup by receipt hash, replay protection
14 unit tests covering all fraud/replay/duplicate/self-report scenarios
protocol_adr_references: spec/11-contribution.md (contribution pipeline: session → measurement → receipt → proof → ledger → Civic Points)
spec/00 §2 (Economics: Contribution ≠ ContributionProof ≠ CivicPoints ≠ Settlement ≠ ExternalCryptocurrency)
known_limitations: The contribution ledger is in-memory only. A production implementation would persist to an append-only store (e.g. SQLite append-only table or a log file).
The bilateral receipt does not include the circuit ID or route ID binding. A follow-up should bind the receipt to the specific circuit that provided the service.
The contribution proof does not yet feed into Civic Points (GATE-12). The ledger tracks proofs but does not compute point values.
